prompt_segment: STEP 1 — FREELANCEMAP PUBLIC PROJECT SEARCH.
Open https://www.freelancermap.com/projects in the Browser Use browser, using the public Projects search page.
Inspect and clear any preselected filters or chips incompatible with the following exact scope, including any geographic exclusion.
Workplace: select ONLY Remote. Explicitly unselect Hybrid and On-site. Do not infer remote eligibility merely from an advertisement title containing the word Remote.
Contract type: select ONLY Freelance. Do not select Permanent or Agency contract.
Countries: ALL countries. Do not choose a country filter. Turn OFF 'Exclude projects from German speaking countries' if it is enabled. Germany, Austria, and Switzerland are included.

Do NOT add other search filters: no keywords, publication date, industry, professional field, direct-client-only, or any additional exclusion. Do not force a particular sorting option; keep the site's default.
Verify the actual active controls/chips after applying the filters. If any required control is unavailable or the page behaves unexpectedly, report the discrepancy instead of claiming success.
Treat filtered results as potential remote/freelance listings, not as globally eligible opportunities: eligibility comes from later, separately approved stages.

Stop this stage after verifying and reporting the effective filters, without collecting listings, reading full details, saving records, applying, or contacting anyone. Later stages, once approved and combined, may add those actions.

prompt_segment: STEP 2 — FREELANCEMAP RESULTS COLLECTION AND LOCAL HISTORY.

After Stage 1's public project search has been verified (Remote only, Freelance only, all countries, no other filters), visit every publicly accessible filtered results page until the last reachable page, subject to website access and usage limits. Never claim full coverage if blocked.
Observe all listed IDs/URLs across pages, but compare them with the site's local persistent baseline before importing.

Import and locally save only opportunities whose site-specific stable project ID (or fallback canonical URL) has not appeared before. Do not import or pass SEEN/previously stored advertisements to the fresh Stage 3 queue. Keep existing records intact.

Keep the persistent baseline and this run's NEW/SEEN counts within this site's own Windows profile/folder, not shared with other website profiles. Exact Windows path and storage format remain unselected until local verification.

Save new raw listing data with available original text, source link/ID and capture timestamp. Store any detected changes to old advertisements only if later explicitly defined; never silently reinterpret SEEN as NEW.

Report actual page coverage, records observed, truly NEW imported, SEEN not imported, local save/readback status, and reasons for PARTIAL failures. Respect access restrictions and quotas. Do not bypass controls.
Stage 2 does not perform suitability filtering or full-detail research, nor contact clients or submit anything. Stage 3 will screen only newly imported raw listings.

stage.input: Only NEW listings that Stage 2 has durably saved for freelancermap, never SEEN/previously ingested listings.
stage.purpose: Fast preliminary suitability exclusion based on evidence available in the saved listing title, excerpt, tags and any saved publicly visible description; do not yet perform exhaustive per-project detail reading.
stage.applicant_context: Owner is Iranian and needs work that can legally and practically be contracted and delivered remotely from Iran. Do not assume unrestricted global eligibility from a Remote tag or employer location.
stage.evaluate_original_language: Interpret or translate any available non-Persian description sufficiently to assess actual restrictions and implicit mandatory conditions, not merely keyword matching.

screen_conditions.topic: Nationality, residency, citizenship and work authorization
screen_conditions.rule: Reject where the ad actually states an incompatible mandatory nationality, citizenship, residence, local work authorization, territorial restriction or national-only eligibility that prevents an Iranian person working from Iran. Worldwide/explicit cross-border eligibility is positive evidence, but silence is not proof of eligibility.

screen_conditions.topic: Work mode and mandatory physical participation
screen_conditions.rule: Reject mandatory on-site visits, hybrid attendance, office presence, physical implementation, site inspection, travel, mandatory relocation, or other physical requirements preventing fully remote delivery from Iran; do not accept a Remote listing badge as overriding incompatible text.

Reject if performance or contracting strictly requires an unavailable professional license, regulated registration, security clearance, government certification, restricted status or other legally necessary approval. A project mentioning German or other national law is not automatically rejected unless a mandatory incompatible license, presence, authorization or legal condition is evidenced.

Reject when the available evidence clearly shows the standalone project is infeasibly large/complex or needs mandatory resources, specialist authorization or capabilities unavailable to the owner; reuse already-approved site/project limits (over 100 estimated hours OR over 10 calendar days for standalone projects) only when sufficiently grounded. Do not guess hours from a vague title or infer that AI can safely perform professional obligations.

Reject a concrete, mandatory incompatible condition that prevents accepting or delivering the assignment from Iran, including restrictive location/physical or non-obtainable legal or regulatory duties. Record exact reason and evidence; do not invent restrictions.

decision_rules.definite_reject: REJECT_PRELIMINARY only for actual, identifiable incompatible mandatory requirements supported by cited listing text or verified site evidence.
decision_rules.no_visible_blocker: PASS_PRELIMINARY when no incompatible condition is evidenced; this means NOT YET REJECTED, not confirmed global eligibility or fit.
decision_rules.missing_or_ambiguous: NEEDS_VERIFICATION when saved listing text is insufficient, unclear or conflicting about a material restriction; do not auto-reject or claim it is definitely eligible. Carry it forward marked uncertain for later detailed inspection rather than dropping it silently.
decision_rules.title_only: Title or remote badge alone is insufficient for a final eligibility approval; maintain uncertainty when key conditions are not available.
decision_rules.evidence: Each excluded item must retain link/project ID, original relevant text when available, translated/paraphrased interpretation, reason code and provenance; no assertion based on hallucinated legal restrictions.

persistence.raw_source: Keep Stage 2 original local site-specific archive and dedup baseline unchanged, including rejected listings for future repeat detection.
persistence.routing: Put PASS_PRELIMINARY and NEEDS_VERIFICATION (with explicit uncertainty flags) into the site's separate next-stage folder/queue. Keep REJECT_PRELIMINARY out of it but retain its raw record and rejection reason in the original site-specific history; do not delete original records.
persistence.duplication_policy: Do not create new copies of old SEEN listings in the next-stage intake. Stage 3 does not erase any existing Windows files or database rows.
persistence.stage_boundary: Only quick preliminary screen here. Full reading of survivor project details, final fit/economic evaluation and reporting are reserved for user-defined later steps.

approved_prompt_segment: Screen only the genuinely NEW freelancermap advertisements saved by Step 2; never re-import old/SEEN opportunities.

Use the available saved original listing text, title, snippets, tags and other already-captured information. Translate where needed to understand mandatory conditions, not just match isolated keywords. Do not yet browse every full project detail page.

Assess whether an Iranian freelancer can realistically and lawfully contract for and deliver the work fully remotely from Iran. Look for explicit or clear mandatory nationality, citizenship, country, residence, work permit, local hiring, on-site/hybrid/travel, professional license, security clearance, jurisdiction-specific regulated-qualification, or other incompatible restrictions.

Reject only if evidence supports a real blocking requirement. For standalone work, rely on the project's existing approved 100-hour/10-day hard limits only when the data supports a sound estimate. Do not invent hours, licensing or country restrictions.

An employer located in Germany or another country, or a local legal/regulatory topic, does not alone disqualify a remote job; look for an actual binding restriction. A Remote label does not guarantee worldwide eligibility.
If no disqualifier is visible, tag PASS_PRELIMINARY; if essential eligibility information is absent or ambiguous, tag NEEDS_VERIFICATION. Neither is final acceptance.

Place PASS_PRELIMINARY and NEEDS_VERIFICATION advertisements in a different, FREELANCEMAP-ONLY local folder/queue for a later, separately approved stage, with uncertainty labels. Keep rejected items out of that next-stage queue; preserve all original raw records and rejection reasons in the site history; do not delete historical data.
Record count and grounded reason codes for NEW assessed, PASS_PRELIMINARY, NEEDS_VERIFICATION and REJECT_PRELIMINARY. Report data/cost/permission failure as PARTIAL rather than claiming completion.
Stop at Stage 3. Do not send applications, contact clients, take payment, modify accounts or execute unsanctioned full-detail inspection.

read_and_persist.read_scope: Read complete accessible original description, including sections on project deliverables, eligibility, location/remote requirements, legal/professional qualifications, workload, timeframe, pay/budget and other mandatory conditions when present.
read_and_persist.no_truncation_claims: If the full text is gated, partially hidden, empty, changed, or inaccessible, record incomplete capture and explicitly mark evidence as insufficient. Do not claim full-text review.
read_and_persist.persist_raw: Save the original-language full text and existing project ID, canonical URL, capture timestamp, relevant page metadata, read completeness and evidence provenance in the site's own Windows working records. Preserve previously captured raw listings and prior-run history; never delete originals.

policy_inputs: Stage 1 Remote-only/Freelance-only search scope and Stage 3 Iranian contractor from Iran with no mandatory incompatible location/nationality/residency/citizenship/work-permit/physical attendance restrictions
Stage 3 qualification, security clearance, mandatory professional licensing, jurisdiction-specific regulatory eligibility and feasibility requirements

Previously approved applicable freelancermap and Opportunity Hunter project rules already present in this profile and POLICY-AND-DECISIONS.md (including 100h/10-calendar-day standalone project ceiling and a USD 5/effective-hour foreign independent-project floor where calculable, without inventing budgets or hours)
Any other explicitly mandatory incompatible requirements found in original full description
final_evaluation.method: Understand/translate original text as needed, inspect all relevant mandatory conditions and practical feasibility. Evaluate only against documented owner-approved rules; do not create new limits or claim legal eligibility without evidence.

status.suitable: SUITABLE_VERIFIED: only with enough evidence that previously defined constraints are satisfied and a realistic, supportable feasibility/payment assessment; do not conflate 'not rejected' with verified suitable.
status.unsuitable: NOT_SUITABLE: genuine disqualifying text or supported infeasibility, with cited evidence and precise reasons.
status.unresolved: NEEDS_CLARIFICATION: key evidence missing or conflicting, such as contractor eligibility from Iran, required qualifications, rate basis, workload or budget; keep it out of the verified suitable folder and retain full text/notes for manual review.

final_evaluation.evidence: For each decision, retain project ID/URL and excerpt or precise source-section references supporting conditions. Preserve unverified assumptions separately from observed text.
final_evaluation.no_external_contact: Do not send proposals, message, request application quota, or contact an employer to resolve uncertainty; that is outside the approved four-stage pilot.

outputs.suitable_content: Only SUITABLE_VERIFIED opportunities with ID, title, direct URL, full saved original description reference/text, evidence-based rationale, cost/work feasibility notes grounded in available facts and capture time.
outputs.unsuitable_and_uncertain: Preserve in site-specific full-detail history with outcome and reason; neither enters the suitable folder. Do not delete the original record or falsely mark unsupported as suitable.

owner_notification.requirement: Tell owner which ads qualified, with direct links, reasons, and counts. Report if no qualified ads found.

outputs.completion_receipt: Summarize number of new records from Stage 2, Stage 3 survivors, detail pages attempted and fully read, SUITABLE_VERIFIED count, NOT_SUITABLE count, NEEDS_CLARIFICATION count, Windows storage readback, inability/blockers, Codex usage/limit signals when visible, and observed timing if measured.

prompt_segment: STEP 4 — FREELANCEMAP COMPLETE PROJECT DETAIL REVIEW AND FINAL REPORT. FINAL STEP: STOP.
From Step 3's FREELANCEMAP-ONLY preliminary survivors, take EVERY newly saved PASS_PRELIMINARY and NEEDS_VERIFICATION listing. Do not revisit historical SEEN listings by default.

Open each selected publicly accessible detail page and read its COMPLETE available project description, in the original language. Save its full original text, project ID, canonical link, capture timestamp and a completeness indicator in the website's own separate Windows local full-detail storage. Verify persistence and do not overwrite or delete raw/original history.

Translate or interpret the actual wording accurately and assess remote delivery and contracting by an Iranian working from Iran; mandatory country/nationality/citizenship/residency/work authorization, office visits/hybrid/travel, professional license, legal jurisdiction, clearance, mandatory communication, cost, duration, effort and practical specialist requirements.

Use ONLY previously owner-approved applicable Stage 3 and site/project policy; apply pre-existing 100-hour/10-day standalone-project boundaries and USD 5/effective-hour foreign-market minimum when calculations are actually supported by evidence. No unsupported guesses of hours or rate units. A country mentioned in a project does not automatically bar a global remote freelancer.

Mark SUITABLE_VERIFIED only if sufficient actual evidence supports meeting the applicable requirements. Mark NOT_SUITABLE with concrete reason if a mandatory condition blocks the owner. Mark NEEDS_CLARIFICATION if essential facts remain missing, contradictory or inaccessible; do not falsely label these suitable.

Write SUITABLE_VERIFIED opportunities only into a distinct 'آگهی‌های مناسب برای ما' collection/folder belonging to freelancermap on the user's Windows computer, keeping the full-description source and direct link. Preserve unsuitable and unclear records and reasons in local website history without putting them in the suitable folder.

Present an owner-facing report in the application's session listing suitable ads and direct links or explicitly report zero; summarize total read, statuses, actual save locations, partial failures and observed execution time/usage when available. Any other notification channel requires separate owner approval.
Stop after the report; no applications, messaging, account changes, purchases, external notifications or further stages.
